_comment: Context that lets each Python block in the docs run on its own. Read by
scripts/check-examples.py. A file's prelude goes in front of every block in that
file. A block's template wraps it: {code} is replaced by the block. Blocks are
numbered from 1 in the order they appear, and first_line must match the block's
first non-blank line, so adding, moving, or editing a block fails the check until
this file is updated. Use skip, with a reason, only for a block that cannot run
as written. Python fragments usually need no entry: any syntactically valid
block, statement, function, or class compiles on its own, which is why this map
is empty while check-examples.py still compiles every block that exists.
A block whose point is deliberately invalid syntax gets a skip here.
